# tomekdot — GitHub Portfolio & Technical Articles

> An interactive developer showcase and research journal featuring PyPlanet and Openplanet plugins, Trackmania tools, agentic AI systems, and academic computer science projects by Tomasz Kaczak (@tomekdot).

## Overview
- Developer: Tomasz Kaczak (@tomekdot)
- Website: https://tomekdot.github.io
- Repository Index: Full indexed open-source repository directory (70+ PyPlanet, Openplanet, AngelScript, Python, TypeScript, Java, C++ projects)
- Technical Journal: Research articles exploring server automation, reactive telemetry, and AI systems

## AI Catalog & Agentic Resource Discovery
- ARD v1.0 Catalog: https://tomekdot.github.io/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- ARD Schema Identifier: `urn:air:tomekdot.github.io:portfolio:repositories`
- Supported AI Models: Google Gemini (Gemini Flash Latest), Ollama (Local PC / Server), LM Studio

## Key Repositories
- [hermes-my-github-plugin](https://github.com/tomekdot/hermes-my-github-plugin): PyPlanet automation plugin providing server stats, telemetry hooks, and administrative tools.
- [trackmania-galaxy](https://github.com/tomekdot/trackmania-galaxy): Interactive Trackmania galaxy encyclopedia, map dataset explorer, and telemetry wiki.
- [pursuit-maps](https://github.com/tomekdot/pursuit-maps): ManiaPlanet Feedback S1 E1 pursuit maps collection with UIDs, thumbnails, and telemetry metadata.
- [event-calendar-dev](https://github.com/tomekdot/event-calendar-dev): OpenPlanet in-game Event Calendar plugin for tracking Trackmania tournaments and broadcasts.
- [opencode-github-repos-panel](https://github.com/tomekdot/opencode-github-repos-panel): OpenCode desktop extension providing interactive GitHub repository search and management.

## Technical Journal Articles
- [Hermes Skills: Modular Extensibility in Modern Autonomous AI](https://tomekdot.github.io/): Architectural analysis of modular agent skills, DevOps automation, and plugin ecosystems under unified standards.
- [PyPlanet ClanSpirits: Architectural Deep Dive into Competitive Server Scoring](https://tomekdot.github.io/): Asynchronous SQLite queries, active team allegiance tracking, and scoring systems on high-traffic Trackmania servers.
- [Pomodoro Timer in Trackmania: Maintain Peak Racing Performance](https://tomekdot.github.io/): Productivity overlay integrated directly into Trackmania with customizable alerts, music controls, and task checklists.
- [A New Plugin for OpenPlanet: Event Calendar](https://tomekdot.github.io/): OpenPlanet and ManiaPlanet add-on for tracking key tournament dates, broadcasts, and community events.
